reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her thread in #north-team. I told her the tip is noted as unverified: someone overheard that Elodie Merriwether is the main contact for the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply.

I checked the brain and public files and found nothing that confirms or contradicts it. Neither Elodie nor a Halyard rollout comes up anywhere. One caveat: the brain is set up for keyword search only, so a note phrased differently could have been missed.

The public notes list Marrow Agrisupply as the Central team's account, so I suggested she ask Central to confirm the contact. Ilse isn't in the Central channels, so I didn't read them for her. I also didn't use `search_messages`, because its results include conversations she can't see.
